name: Abhishek Finlease Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Abhishek Finlease Ltd deals in finance and investments as an NBFC
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1][2]
Company is a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking NBFC which provides:
a) Long term Finance investments 
b) Short term Finance investments
c) Tax Consultancy
d) Loan against Shares
e) Margin Funding
f) IPO Financing

cons: Stock is trading at 3.16 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.92% over last 3 years.
